status: Local final replay protocol after source inspection and an exploratory one-round calibration; not externally preregistered or an independent holdout
models: Three EPCIS selected-clause profile strengthenings, one official JSON-schema identity control, three FHIR selected invariant version pairs and their three identity controls
classification_workload: Every distinct supported old-sufficient observation class, all masks, both old verdicts
replay_workload: One synthetic representative per model Cartesian state; old receipt acquired by fixed block-order influential-field policy
receipt_evidence: Complete retained grouped payloads and sufficient old observations, immutable snapshot/domain/predicate binding; old label does not independently restrict the completion domain
shared_planner: Controlled finite replay with the same compiled target fibers; no whole-validator runtime comparison
static_delta: Verify old-label implication or old-label plus declared changed dependencies; fall back to all target dependencies if neither is sound
bundled_behavior: First source request returns all named groups, all delivered bytes/groups are charged and all fields immediately become known
round_order: Rotate the five strategy names by round index; fixed synthetic state order
included_runtime: UTF-8 JSON decoding, raw payload/category consistency, snapshot binding, applicable receipt proof, new decision, diagnostic witness materialization for audit, sufficient replacement serialization
separate_costs: Model compilation, shared planner compilation, block codec verification, fixture preparation, old acquisition
excluded: Source download, disk/network I/O, durable output writes, clinical/business truth, arbitrary unsupported standard clauses
interpretation: Exact declared finite fragments and local component costs. No operational frequencies, speed guarantees, clinical outcomes, or acceptance prediction
